# Fixture for BP-PY-41 (safe) — delegates to helper with bare assert (safer/niquests FP)
lang: python
file: test/test_dump_safe.py

def _inner_test_roundtrip(data):
    dump(data, "one")
    with open("one") as fp:
        assert load(fp) == data


def test_dump():
    data = _inner_test_roundtrip({"a": 1})
    if data:
        save_coverage(data)
